question.questionText: The news _______ as soon as possible.
question.explanationHtml:
Detailed Explanation:
In this sentence, 'The news _______ as soon as possible.', the subject 'The news' is singular and refers to information. The sentence requires a passive voice construction because the news is being released by someone (the agent is not important or not mentioned). The correct passive future simple structure is 'will be + past participle'.
  • will be released (verb phrase (future simple passive)): This is the passive form of the future simple tense: 'will be' + past participle. It means that the news will be made public by someone in the future.
  • are released (verb phrase (present simple passive)): This is the present simple passive form. It is not correct here because the sentence refers to a future action.
  • will release (verb phrase (future simple active)): This is the active form of the future simple tense. It would require a subject (who will release the news), but 'the news' cannot perform the action.
  • will have been released (verb phrase (future perfect passive)): This is the future perfect passive form. It means the action will be completed before a certain time in the future, but the sentence does not indicate such a time.
Related structure or vocabulary: Passive voice in future simple: will be + past participle

  • are released (cụm động từ (thì hiện tại đơn bị động)): Đây là dạng bị động của thì hiện tại đơn. Không phù hợp vì câu nói về hành động trong tương lai.
